step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows an automated multi-account AWS provisioning flow. A internal user interacts with an ITSM tool, triggering Control Tower in the Root account to vend a new AWS account. Service Catalog deploys a VPC into the vended account, which connects via Transit Gateway to the central Network account.
